item.tib: khro rgyal lha rgod thog pa'i mngon rtogs 'dod dgu bang mdzod
item.coloph: ces lha rgod mngon rtogs 'di ni mkhas grub rnams la bshad pa ci 'os rung / rang 'dra blo dman rnams la phan snyam nas/ dga' ba chu 'brug zla 'brug gi nyin/ dbra btsun shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i gling du bsgrigs pa'o//
